cohort: 21 term singleton SGA newborn infants and 21 age- and sex-matched appropriate for gestational age (AGA) term neonates born by elective cesarean section
finding: SGA neonates had increased MDA levels and decreased SOD activity in umbilical cord blood compared to AGA neonates, suggesting insufficient protection against oxidative stress.
mod_finding: All study participants gave birth via elective cesarean section.
